properties.name: grails.security.headers.enabled
properties.description: Whether Grails registers the default servlet HTTP security headers filter.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.content-type-options.enabled
properties.description: Whether to send the X-Content-Type-Options response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.content-type-options.value
properties.description: Value for the X-Content-Type-Options response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.frame-options.enabled
properties.description: Whether to send the X-Frame-Options response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.frame-options.value
properties.description: Value for the X-Frame-Options response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.referrer-policy.enabled
properties.description: Whether to send the Referrer-Policy response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.referrer-policy.value
properties.description: Value for the Referrer-Policy response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.xss-protection.enabled
properties.description: Whether to send the X-XSS-Protection response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.xss-protection.value
properties.description: Value for the X-XSS-Protection response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.hsts.enabled
properties.description: Whether to send Strict-Transport-Security on secure requests.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.hsts.value
properties.description: Value for the Strict-Transport-Security response header when HSTS is enabled and the request is secure.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.content-security-policy.enabled
properties.description: Whether to send the Content-Security-Policy response header.

properties.name: grails.security.headers.content-security-policy.value
properties.description: Value for the Content-Security-Policy response header when CSP is enabled.
